detailed_description:
The target video is a whimsical fantasy VFX short in one continuous 5-second take, shot from a locked overhead top-down perspective looking down onto the twilight canal town of <Picture 1>: dark wooden stilted buildings with warm lit windows and eave lights along the far bank, green canal water with reflections, the black awning boat moored at lower left, overhanging tree leaves framing the top edge, and a few figures seated on stone steps. Soft twilight realism in the environment contrasts with vivid golden VFX at the center of frame.
[Shot 1] The single continuous overhead shot begins from <Picture 1>, with <Subject 1>, the cloud-headed mascot with white cloud head, black oval eyes, gentle smile, orange top with white cuffs and chest band, white pants and boots, centered on the canal-side ground. From 0 to 1.5 seconds, the mascot draws a radiant golden sphere out of its own body — a soft shimmering hum rises as the orb emerges glowing from its chest and brightens as it forms between its hands. From 1.5 to 2.3 seconds, <Subject 1> hurls the orb forward with a whoosh; it lands on the ground a short distance away, and at 2.3 seconds it erupts in a dazzling burst of light with a bright resonant flare, instantly morphing into a swirling, stable glowing golden portal. Nearby, <Subject 2>, the young man with short black hair wearing the black T-shirt with verbatim yellow "ODOS ODOS ODOS / CLASS OF 2026" print, reacts with wide-eyed, open-mouthed surprise, leaning back slightly. From 3 to 5 seconds, <Subject 1> takes <Subject 2>'s hand and the two walk together into the portal, which glows warmly as they step in; the camera executes only a very subtle slow push-in toward the portal during these final seconds. The portal's golden glow reflects softly on the canal water below. The portal's low magical hum continues to the final frame, where the take cuts off as the two characters finish entering.
No dialogue, no speech, and no on-screen text at any point.

overall_soundscape:
Soft twilight canal-town room tone throughout: faint distant water lapping, light evening breeze in the overhanging leaves. Diegetic VFX sounds: a shimmering golden hum as the orb forms (0–1.5s), a whoosh on the throw (1.5–2.3s), a bright resonant flare/impact as the orb lands and transforms (~2.3s), and a low magical hum from the stable portal through 5s.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, wonder-filled fantasy underscore — soft celesta and warm strings — swelling gently as the portal opens and the two characters enter, resolving softly at the cut-off with no dramatic swell.
